title: Finance Reporting
subtitle: Report Library · Admin walkthrough for finance teams

intro.title: Finance Report Library
lines: Every finance report your organization needs, in one place.
Rec is an all-in-one finance platform — all payment processor data
is reflected here, so statuses are always up to date.
intro.narration: Welcome to Rec's Finance Report Library, home to every finance report your organization needs in one place. Rec is an all-in-one finance platform for finance teams — every payment your processor handles is reflected here, so you always have an up-to-date view of transaction statuses. Let's walk through what's available.

steps.title: Transaction Log
lines: Every payment and refund, with customer, location, method, and status.
Pulled straight from your payment processor, so status is always current.
steps.narration: The Transaction Log lists every payment and refund across the organization, with customer, location, method, and status for each one. Because this data pulls straight from your payment processor, the status you see here — Paid, Refunded, Canceled — is always current.

steps.title: Transaction Detail
lines: Items, activity log, and the exact ledger entries a transaction generated.
This refund is broken into debit and credit entries by GL code.
steps.narration: Opening a single transaction shows its full detail: the items involved, a timestamped activity log, and the exact ledger entries it generated. Here, a refund is broken into debit and credit entries by GL code, ready for reconciliation.

steps.title: Item Log
lines: Every product, fee, and tax line sold, down to the individual item.
Each row is tagged with its GL code, item type, and payment method.
steps.narration: The Item Log breaks transactions down to the individual item level — every product, fee, and tax line sold, each tagged with its GL code, item type, and payment method.

steps.title: GL Code Rollup
lines: Payments and refunds totaled by GL code and desk location.
A fast way to reconcile before posting to your accounting system.
steps.narration: GL Code Rollup totals payments and refunds by GL code and desk location, showing the net dollar amount for each — a fast way to reconcile before posting to your accounting system.

steps.title: Payment Processing Status
lines: Every transaction's lifecycle status — Paid, Refunded, or Canceled.
Mirrors your payment processor in real time — no separate dashboard needed.
steps.narration: Payment Processing Status tracks each transaction's lifecycle, from Paid to Refunded or Canceled, with a reason noted where one applies. Since Rec mirrors your payment processor in real time, finance teams can rely on this view instead of checking a separate processor dashboard.

steps.title: A/R Aging by Plan
lines: Outstanding balance on every payment plan, by aging bucket.
Totals at the top show what's upcoming versus past due.
steps.narration: A/R Aging by Plan shows the outstanding balance on every payment plan, broken into aging buckets from current out to ninety-plus days, with totals for what's upcoming versus past due.

steps.title: Payment Plan Detail
lines: Full installment schedule, activity log, and linked account IDs.
steps.narration: Drilling into a single plan shows its full installment schedule, an activity log of payments and changes, and the linked plan and account IDs.

steps.title: Account Credit Log
lines: Every account credit deposit and spend, staff member, and note.
steps.narration: The Account Credit Log records every account credit deposit and spend, along with the staff member who made the change and any note they left.

steps.title: Custom Reports
lines: Built by your success manager, or saved from a Seb conversation.
Seb, Rec's in-platform AI coordinator, can build a report in seconds.
steps.narration: The Custom tab holds reports built by your success manager, or saved directly from a conversation with Seb — Rec's in-platform AI coordinator. When a standard report doesn't cover what you need, Seb can build a custom finance report in seconds, just by describing it.

steps.title: Ask Seb for a Report
lines: Describe the report in plain language — Seb returns it in seconds.
steps.narration: Here, Seb was asked for this week's program bookings and revenue, with payment plan revenue called out separately — and it returned a formatted report in seconds, no data request needed.

steps.title: Turn It Into a Routine
lines: Any Seb report can run on a schedule and email itself to you.
This one runs every Monday morning, automatically.
steps.narration: Any report Seb builds can become a routine. This one runs every Monday morning, generates the report as a PDF, and emails it automatically, so finance teams get their numbers without asking.
